ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic map of a certain region of China. The left map is marked with a latitude and longitude range of about 25°N—30°N, 110°E—114°E; the enlarged map on the right labels “Dongting Lake”, and place names such as “Yichang”, “Chenglingji”, and “Changsha” can be seen. The legend also shows information such as hydropower stations, antimony, lead and zinc. The figure shows that Dongting Lake is located in the central inland region of China, and belongs to a lake on land and its basin water system. Reasoning: The question asks to determine the “type of internal cycle that the Dongting Lake basin participates in”. In the water cycle, if the internal cycle occurs within the land area, it is called a terrestrial internal cycle; if it occurs within the ocean area, it is called a marine internal cycle. The Dongting Lake basin is located inside the land and is not an ocean area, so the type of internal cycle it participates in is the terrestrial internal cycle.
